source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ID,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS ID,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(YearMonth,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS YearMonth,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SKU_Code,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS SKU_Code,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Unit_Quantity,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS Unit_Quantity,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RRP_EA,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS RRP_EA,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(RRP_Cases,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS RRP_Cases,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SKU_Group,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS SKU_Group,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Key_SKU,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS Key_SKU,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SKU_Group_DSA,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS SKU_Group_DSA,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(KEY_Group_DSA,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS KEY_Group_DSA,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SKU_GroupCode_KEYSKU,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS SKU_GroupCode_KEYSKU,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(KEY_GroupName_KEYSKU,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS KEY_GroupName_KEYSKU,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(insertUser,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS insertUser,
CreateTime,
UpdateTime,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(KEY_SKU_KEYSKU,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS KEY_SKU_KEYSKU,
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(SKU_Group_DSA_Name,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),' ','') AS SKU_Group_DSA_Name,
getdate() CreateON_L1 from [dbo].[DM_D_SKU_GROUP] with(nolock)
where Convert(varchar(100),CreateTime,23) >= format(dateadd(DD,-1,getdate()),'yyyy-MM-dd')
and Convert(varchar(100),CreateTime,23) <= format(dateadd(DD,-1,getdate()),'yyyy-MM-dd')
